title: FLA sound envelope inPoint/outPoint/loop from binary import silently skipped
description: flash8-binary.ts line 1856-1863 reads soundLoop, soundSync, inPoint44, outPoint44 from frame sound records, but Fla8SoundInfo only stores sound name; envelope points are skipped (r.skip(cnt*8)). Fix: decode and store soundLoop, syncMode, inPoint, outPoint in Fla8SoundInfo and pass them to SoundLinkage in flash8-import.ts.
